$comment: Per-card byte budget. Enforced by scripts/measure-bytes.mjs. See README.md for what is and is not counted.
rationale: 150 KiB gzipped per card. Upstream publishes no per-component sizes, so this ceiling is ours to set. A WebGL card that fits under 150 KiB gzipped is small enough that one card's cost is not a page-load decision. The heaviest card in this gallery is an order of magnitude under the ceiling; the ceiling is a regression gate, not a tuning target.

counts.ownChunkGzip: Gzipped bytes of the card's own JavaScript chunk, after tree-shaking, excluding shared chunks.
counts.assetBytes: Raw (uncompressed) bytes of textures, models, HDRIs and fonts the card references. Zero for every card here: all 17 are procedural shader or DOM cards with no binary assets.
counts.sharedRuntimeGzip: Gzipped bytes of chunks shared by every card (React, Three.js, shared vendor modules). Reported once at page level, never charged to a single card, because no single card causes it.

doesNotCount: sourcemap files, which are a debugging aid and are not fetched by a browser
the HTML document and page CSS, which are page-level rather than per-card costs
